info.name: Deprecated eToro Public API operations Agent Portfolios Attachments API

params.name: client_request_id
params.description: Client-generated correlation ID (UUID). Required for request tracing and idempotency.

items.docs: Two-step media upload: clients first upload a file here to receive an Attachment object, then pass its url in a POST /feeds/post or POST /reactions/.../comment payload. Accepts multipart/form-data with a binary file field. Supported formats: JPEG and PNG. Maximum file size: 8 MB (8,388,608 bytes). The returned url is a plain CDN URL scoped to the uploading user.
